title: go.mod marks the directly imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:14 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 // indirect` while store.go:7 imports `_ "modernc.org/sqlite"` directly; go.mod has no direct require block
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency is listed without the // indirect marker

title: Return values of JSON encode/decode are discarded
evidence: handlers.go:30 `json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)` ignores the error; main_test.go:42, main_test.go:99 and main_test.go:100 ignore the json.Unmarshal error, so a malformed response body would surface only as a misleading count/field mismatch
suggestion: Log the encode error in writeJSON and fail the test on a non-nil Unmarshal error

title: PUT is a full replacement: omitted year/isbn are reset to zero values
evidence: handlers.go:124-129 decodes a fresh Book and store.go:92 overwrites all four columns, so `PUT /books/1 {"title":"a","author":"b"}` sets year=0 and isbn=''; README.md:24 documents this as 'Replace/update'
suggestion: Acceptable for PUT semantics; add PATCH if partial update is wanted

title: Health check does not probe the database
evidence: handlers.go:79-81 returns {"status":"ok"} unconditionally without calling db.Ping
suggestion: Optionally ping the store and return 503 when SQLite is unreachable

title: Enhancements beyond spec: body size cap, negative-year validation, id validation, Location header
evidence: handlers.go:58 http.MaxBytesReader 1 MiB; handlers.go:71 rejects year < 0; handlers.go:48 rejects non-numeric or <1 ids with 400; handlers.go:93 sets Location on 201
